boundary.statement: Synthetic sandbox: no real money, customers or provider accounts. The workbench called no provider; reprocessing fulfils orders from captures it had already received and captures nothing.

hash_rule: Database-local numbers are taken out first. Each inbox row number in the hashed sections (an `inbox_id`, each number in `superseded_inbox_ids`, the N of an `obs_inbox_N` observation ID or of `inbox row N` in a check's details) becomes its rank among them in ascending order, from 1; each target's observations are then sorted by their canonical JSON; and `plan_hash`, `planned_evidence_version` and `evidence_version_at_execution`, computed from those numbers, are left out.

checks.description: plan, approval and targets belong to this run
the plan is in the approved state
the plan has not expired on the replay clock
the stored plan still hashes to the approved plan hash
the policy version is the one the plan was built under
an approval exists for this plan
the approver is a human operator
the approval names this exact plan hash
the approval has not expired on the replay clock
the deployed handler is the one the fix was validated against

every target is still eligible on a fresh projection: unfulfilled, not cancelled or refunded, exactly one capture (a second capture blocks) matching the order in amount and currency, no unresolved attempt, no conflict, nothing stale; a capture that followed a reported failure counts
the targets' evidence version equals the plan's
no action exists yet for this operation key
the corrected handler, run once more on every target inside the transaction, asks to fulfil exactly that order and payment, for its amount and currency

value.additional_captured_definition: New provider captures this action caused. Reprocessing fulfils captures already received, so it is 0.
value.restored_processing_value_definition: Order value of the orders this action fulfilled whose capture was known before it ran: money already collected, now processed. Not new revenue.
value.unresolved_value_definition: Order value of this plan's candidate orders still unfulfilled after this action, whether left out at planning or not fulfilled at execution; an order with no order record is counted, not summed.
